_comment: Ground truth for orders-service, by design of the code. 'vulnerability' matches an OSV id or alias; '*' covers the artifact's other advisories. 'reachable' is yes/no.

entries.evidence: NotificationFormatter.format calls StringSubstitutor.createInterpolator().replace() on the message template
No other commons-text feature is used
ConfigImporter.importConfig calls new Yaml().load() on an uploaded document
Router.route calls AntPathMatcher.match with the client-supplied path
Only ImmutableList.of is used; Files.createTempDir and FileBackedOutputStream are not
Declared but never used; only mentioned in a comment
